A clean retro 2D pixel art sprite sheet for a top-down arcade racing game, strictly matching the 8-bit/16-bit arcade pixel art style and color palette of the reference image.

The background MUST be a single 100% SOLID FLAT CHROMA GREEN (#00FF00).
DO NOT DRAW ANY CHECKERBOARD PATTERN. DO NOT DRAW ANY GREY SQUARES OR FAKE TRANSPARENCY PATTERNS.

Solid flat #00FF00 green background behind everything. Cleanly spaced grid, crisp pixel art edges.
